title: Naturalist reacts: a tiger playing in a pool
storyboard: Film: naturalist in corner inset reacting to the clip (surprise, then explain), green screen, 2 takes
caption:
Cute clip. Here's the context.

Britannica notes tigers evolved in the forests of eastern Asia and tolerate heat less than other big cats, which may be why they bathe.
